current_data_sources: Customer-supplied enterprise documents, PDFs and filings
Images, video and audio (including sensor and claims media)
Customer data estates, processed in-tenant or private cloud with zero data retention

structured, timestamped, schema-mapped data pipelines — ready for on-prem or private cloud deployment
replaces fragmented data pipelines and manual labeling vendors with a unified multimodal data API

newsletter_capability_detail: Searched the homepage, all solution copy, the blog index, the BFSI case study and the careers page: no newsletter, publication, sponsor or editorial-corpus mention. Their only text sources are customer documents and emails, curated for model training rather than for company intelligence. No public API reference or docs site and no pricing page (the /pricing URL renders the homepage).

likely_buyer_role: Head of Data Partnerships / founding Product Manager (platform data sourcing); no evidence a newsletter-corpus buyer role exists

contact_route.note: Address published in the site footer ('Talk to us'); no named person with public profile verified.

caveats: Supply-side data-curation vendor, not a buyer of newsletter intelligence: they sell multimodal data pipelines to physical-AI, BFSI and industrial customers, and NF's entity-extracted newsletter corpus does not map to their workloads. Seed-stage ($5M) with no public docs, API reference or pricing page, so procurement and budget are unverified.
